_about: Milestone 05 end-to-end gate expectations. Every value carries its source and confidence; the gate judges PASS/FAIL only against CONFIRMED/HIGH entries, PARTIAL/UNKNOWN entries are reported as INFO/KNOWN. Sources: RE-Workspace notes/MILESTONE05_FRONTEND_MATCH_BOOTSTRAP.md (RE f1ca8a5..85e340c, cited 'RE n.n'), notes/MILESTONE05_FRONTEND_GAMEPLAY_BLOCKERS.md (RE 85e340c, cited 'BLK x'), AssetTools manifests/frontend_*.json (AssetTools cc9773e..12308aa), Systems FIDELITY.md MILESTONE 05/06 (agents/systems 3d295ec), Gameplay FIDELITY PASS 20 (agents/gameplay d541c78) for rebuild-side measurements only. Superseded values are listed under retired.

minimap.value: none: no minimap, radar or compass; the only spatial cues are damage-direction arrows, missile-lock warnings, Canvas objective markers with off-screen arrows and ally name tags
